input.subject: R/PM013-1 – Dishwasher repair, Flat 2, 42 Beacon Close, Bellmere, ZZ4 2ZZ – appointment status
input.body:
Dear Harbour Surveying,

Thank you for your email today about the integrated dishwasher repair at Flat 2, 42 Beacon Close, Bellmere, ZZ4 2ZZ (ref R/PM013-1). Unfortunately its content hasn't come through legibly on our system, and neither has your email of 1 October.

Could you please reply with the date and time of the visit you have arranged with the tenant, Nora Palmer? If no visit is booked yet, please tell us what is holding it up (for example, if you are still waiting for the dishwasher make and model from the tenant) and we will help sort it out.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings Maintenance

input.reason: Contractor emails (events 011, 017) have no readable content. Asked Harbour Surveying to confirm the appointment date/time or say what's blocking it (e.g. dishwasher model from the tenant). If they don't reply, escalate: 3+ reminders already sent (event 016).

result.summary: The job is in scheduling. Harbour Surveying was assigned on 1 Oct. They tried to reach the tenant and spoke to her about the dishwasher model, then went quiet through three reminders. They emailed today (event 017), but the email has no readable content, and neither does their 1 Oct email. I've asked them to confirm the visit date and time, or say what is holding it up. The ticket is on hold until tomorrow, and I'll escalate if they don't reply.
result.situation: Routine repair: the integrated dishwasher starts, beeps, the power light flashes and it stops. The landlord was told on 1 Oct that an engineer would attend (event 002). Harbour Surveying and the tenant missed each other on the phone, then spoke (event 010). The tenant couldn't give the model at the time and they agreed to keep in touch by text. The reminders went out on 4 and 5 Oct, then the system flagged 3+ reminders (event 016). The contractor emailed on 6 Oct (event 017), but the content isn't visible.
